newsitem.title: USA: Phillips to pursue new projects in China.
newsitem.headline: Phillips to pursue new projects in China.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co said Monday it signed a letter of intent with China Petrochemical Corp (SINOPEC) to cooperate in developing new projects in China and to share technology and financial resources.
SINOPEC is responsible for operation of all petrochemical businesses in China and is the majority holder in Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd , the country's largest petrochemical processor.

Phillips already is working with Shanghai Petrochemical on a joint-venture high-density polyethylene plant in Jinshanwei expected to be completed in 1998. The plant will manufacture 220 million pounds of polyethylene annually for markets in China and the Pacific Rim. Phillips holds a 40 percent interest in the project.

In the letter of intent, Phillips agreed to study the feasibility of expanding the plant by an additional 440 million to 450 million pounds a year, with Phillips holding a 40 to 50 percent interest in the additional capacity.
